children: Israel medical imaging tech firm's Q2 revenue grew 37% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Adjusted net loss for Q2 missed analyst expectations
Company recorded $40.7 mln impairment charge related to AI solutions business unit
Company expects Korea restructuring to generate annual cost savings of $2 mln starting in 2027
Company plans to continue raising funds to support operations and strengthen balance sheet
Company is pursuing a potential new CMS reimbursement pathway to support broader adoption
HEALTH IT CONSOLIDATION - Revenue growth driven primarily by consolidation of Nanox Health IT business, which contributed $0.9 mln in Q2
IMPAIRMENT CHARGE - Co recorded $40.7 mln impairment charge related to AI solutions business unit, triggered by share price decline and reduced revenue forecasts
KOREA RESTRUCTURING - Co undertook restructuring of Korea operations, including workforce reduction and transition of chip manufacturing to third parties, expected to generate cost savings in 2027
